text:
deploy-bot: Starting multi-service fanout deploy to production (change window) — env=prod, tag=release-2026-03-12, commit=abc1234def, services=[runtime, api, console], strategy=staggered-waves, canary=runtime:10% :rocket:

Alice: ack. will watch dashboards and traces.

Bob: runtime canary -> started. routing 10% traffic.

Carlos: api queued for wave 2. prepping schema migrations readiness check.

Elena: console queued behind api, holding on migrations pass.

deploy-bot: runtime canary succeeded (10% -> 100%) — completed in 2m, p95/p99 within SLOs.

Bob: runtime looks stable. no error spike on traces. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Beginning api rollout: 5% -> 50% -> 70%..

deploy-bot: ALERT: api @ 70% — error-rate spike above threshold (5xx). details: service=api, region=us-west1, error=502 upstream.

Carlos: seeing the 502s in logs. backend-team? @backend-team any deploys or infra changes?

Diane: not aware of infra changes from ops. forwarding to backend-team.

Carlos: aborting api rollout. recommending rollback to previous stable tag release-2026-03-11 and pin until root cause identified.

Alice: agreed. pin api -> release-2026-03-11, hold console rollout.

Carlos: running rollback command:
```
./deploy rollback --service api --to-tag release-2026-03-11 --reason "502 spike during rollout"
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for api -> target=release-2026-03-11, initiated_by=Carlos.

deploy-bot: Rollback progress: terminating in-flight canary tasks, redeploying replicas -> 60% -> 100%.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. api healthy at release-2026-03-11. error-rate returned to baseline.

Elena: console rollout resumed but will remain dependent on api pin (console will target release-2026-03-12 while calling pinned api).

deploy-bot: Fanout completed: runtime=release-2026-03-12, api=release-2026-03-11 (pinned), console=release-2026-03-12 (deployed with api pinned). total duration ~18m.

Diane: creating release note and incident ticket: summary -> api rolled back due to upstream 502s during rollout; pinned to previous stable; assigned to backend-team for RCA.

Bob: will collect traces and a few request ids around the spike and add to incident.

Alice: creating a quick post-deploy checklist: 1) confirm canaries, 2) confirm backward-compatible changes, 3) add feature flags if needed.

Carlos: follow-up: I've pinned the api in the service registry and updated canary thresholds in the deploy config.

deploy-bot: If you want to re-run a new rollout after fixes, use `./deploy promote --service api --to-tag release-2026-03-12 --canary 5%` and coordinate with eng-releases.

Diane: noted. tagging @backend-team and support for monitoring.

Alice: good catch by the alerts. logging this under CHANGE-2213.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot. React with :repeat: to reopen or post new status updates.
